properties.name: WhoisFreaks - burst of newly registered domains
properties.query:
let current = union WhoisFreaksNRD_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDNoWhois_CL
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
  | summarize CurrentCount = dcount(domain_name);
let baseline = union WhoisFreaksNRD_CL, WhoisFreaksNRDNoWhois_CL
  | where TimeGenerated between (ago(8d) .. ago(1d))
  | summarize DailyCount = dcount(domain_name) by bin_at(TimeGenerated, 1d, now())
  | summarize BaselineAvg = avg(DailyCount), BaselineStdev = stdev(DailyCount), BaselineDays = count();
current
| extend JoinKey = 1
| join kind=inner (baseline | extend JoinKey = 1) on JoinKey
| where BaselineDays >= 3
| where CurrentCount > BaselineAvg * 1.5 and CurrentCount > BaselineAvg + 3 * BaselineStdev
| project TimeGenerated = now(), CurrentCount, BaselineAvg = round(BaselineAvg), BaselineStdev = round(BaselineStdev), BaselineDays
properties.description: Identifies unusually large NRD ingest volume that may indicate bulk registration campaigns. The NRD feeds are polled once a day, so the rule compares the last 24 hours of distinct domains against the average of the previous seven daily loads and alerts only when the current load is at least 50% above that average and more than three standard deviations from it.
